prompt:
Generate a single 1536x1024 landscape image: a flat, screenshot-like UI mockup of one signed-in web app screen, the /brief page of a product called Pemby, at desktop width. Match the attached reference image's visual world precisely — its white ground, near-black heavy geometric type, flat saturated yellow/red/blue accent tiles, fully-rounded black pill buttons, and white cards with large radii and soft wide shadows — but this is the working product screen, not a marketing page, so it is denser, calmer and has no illustration and no hero.

STRUCTURE:
1. A nav row across the top on white: at the left a small circular black logo mark and the wordmark 'Pemby' in heavy weight; in the middle four text destinations 'Brief', 'Profile', 'Settings', 'Passes', with 'Brief' in full-strength near-black heavy weight and the rest in warm grey regular; at the right a small circular black avatar-less icon button.
2. Beneath it, generous white space, then the statement set very large and very heavy in near-black, sentence case, tightly leaded, on one or two lines: 'Three roles can hire you from Moldova today.' Directly beneath it in warm grey at a comfortable size: 'Sunday 21 September · every role re-checked on the company board within 12 hours'.
3. Then three match cards stacked down the page, each a white card with 24px radius and a soft wide diffuse shadow, generously padded, separated by clear gaps, each laid out horizontally: at the far left a large solid accent-coloured rounded square tile about 56px carrying a simple white line icon — green #17A35B for the first two cards, yellow #FFC629 for the third. Next to the tile, the role title in heavy near-black at a large size with the company name beneath it in warm grey. Beneath those, a row of small pill-shaped tags in very light grey with near-black text carrying the reasons. Then the gap line in warm grey. At the right end of the card, the score as a very large very heavy near-black numeral with a small warm-grey label 'match' beneath it, and beneath that a solid black fully-rounded pill button reading 'Apply' with two quiet grey text links 'Save' and 'Not for me' beneath it.
   Card one: green tile, 'Senior Frontend Engineer', 'Hallow Systems', tier pill reading 'Hires from your country' in a light green fill with dark green text, reason tags 'B2B contractor listed', 'TypeScript and React match', '6h time zone overlap', gap line 'Gap — no Next.js in your CV', score 92.
   Card two: green tile, 'Staff Software Engineer', 'Verdant Grid', tier pill 'Hires from your country', reason tags 'EOR named in the posting', '7 years meets the 5+ ask', 'salary band published', gap line 'Gap — Kubernetes asked, not in your CV', score 88.
   Card three: yellow tile, 'Frontend Engineer', 'Marlow & Quinn', tier pill 'Likely' in a light yellow fill with dark amber text, reason tags 'Contractors in Eastern Europe on the team page', 'React 19 match', gap line 'Gap — no public country list', score 84.
4. Beneath the three cards, a wider full-width white card with 24px radius and a soft shadow, carrying 'Near misses' in heavy near-black at its left, and to its right three items in a row, each a small solid accent-coloured rounded square tile followed by a very large heavy numeral and a warm-grey label: a red #F03A3F tile with '3' and 'blocked by country (US only)'; a blue #1B6BFF tile with '2' and 'blocked by way of working (employee only)'; a yellow #FFC629 tile with '1' and 'closed since yesterday'.
5. At the foot of the page on the white ground, a quiet horizontal legend of the three eligibility tiers, each a small coloured dot and its word: a green dot 'Hires from your country', a yellow dot 'Likely', a hollow grey dot 'Unclear'. Small and unobtrusive at the far right: 'EXAMPLE — SYNTHETIC DATA'.
The focal moment is the very large heavy statement at the top; the cards beneath it are even, calm and repetitive. There is no illustration anywhere on this screen and no black background band.

THE WORLD — taken from the attached reference image, which is the binding visual reference. Match its
palette, its type weight and scale, its component shapes, its illustration style and its energy exactly.
Ground: pure white #FFFFFF. Ink: near-black #101010 for all primary text, #6E6E73 for secondary.
Accents, used as FLAT SATURATED FILLS and never as tints: yellow #FFC629, red #F03A3F, blue #1B6BFF,
plus green #17A35B. No gradients on any accent. No pastel versions of these.
Type: ONE heavy geometric grotesk with a large x-height, in the character of the reference's display
face. Display headings are very large, very heavy (800), tightly tracked and tightly leaded, sentence
case. Body is the same family at regular weight, comfortable size, warm grey. No serif anywhere. No
monospace anywhere.
Components, exactly as the reference draws them: fully-rounded black pill buttons with white text and
generous horizontal padding; a fully-rounded white pill input with a soft shadow and a solid black
circular icon button at its right end; white cards with a large 24px radius and a soft wide diffuse
shadow, LAYERED and OVERLAPPING each other at slight offsets rather than sitting in a neat grid; solid
accent-coloured rounded squares about 14px radius used as icon tiles with simple white line icons
inside them; an outlined pill containing a long right arrow.
Illustration: flat vector, bold confident black outlines, flat fills in the accent colours, with simple
geometric shapes — a circle, a square — sitting behind the figure as flat colour blocks. Friendly,
modern, confident. Never 3D, never gradient-shaded, never photographic, never isometric.
Energy: bold, high-contrast, confident and friendly. Lots of white space around very heavy type.

FORBIDDEN, non-negotiable, these break the product's binding rules:
No search bar. No job feed. No "Post a Job", no "Hire", no employer-facing anything — there are no
employer accounts. Never use the words: job board, recruiter, recruitment, placement, get hired,
guaranteed job, auto-apply, scrape, beat the ATS. No statistics of any kind — no member counts, no
company counts, no "people got hired", no percentages, no ratings, no stars, no testimonials, no press
logos. No real company logos or names of real companies. No avatars or photographs of people.
Also: no device frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no desk, no perspective, no tilt, no drop shadow
around the whole screen. The image IS the screen, edge to edge. All text crisp, correctly spelled and
rendered exactly as specified. No lorem ipsum, no invented extra text.
referenceNote: Derived from an owner-pinned third-party page held locally and deliberately not published (2026-09-21). This comp plus PRODUCT.md's written world description is the durable record.
